yarn-troppo.meaning: Every action, rate, date and vote is kept, and the directive and statement are left verbatim and flagged: "Here it is, word for word:". "that's the bit that's got their goat" attributes an irritation the minutes never state.
yarn-troppo.sense: Terms mostly fit ("barely budged", "kept chugging along", "dead set on its dual-mandate goals", "They knocked off at 10:15 a.m."), but "got their goat" (annoyed them) is the wrong sense for a policy concern.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Natural Australian phrasing: "whack the target range for the federal funds rate up", "putting it in black and white", "sooner rather than later", with "per cent" spelt the local way outside the quotes.
yarn-troppo.register: Level-4 voice right through the prose sections, no swearing (allowed): "Everyone agreed the Committee's next get-together would be held".
yarn-troppo.tone: Formal minutes retold as a chat, which the brief allows, but a few tags tip toward flippant: "No ifs or buts.", "Voting against this action: None. Not a single one."
yarn-troppo.flow: Reads well, though the asides chop it: "putting it in black and white in the postmeeting statement that it \"will deliver price stability.\" No ifs or buts."
yarn-troppo.variety: Wide range: "whack", "chugging along", "running hot", "black and white", "bump up", "give ... the nod", "knocked off", "signed off".
yarn-troppo.essence: Unmistakably the FOMC minutes, structure and quoted directive intact: "Notation Vote".

dinkum-3.meaning: Every point kept, quotes left verbatim: "all members agreed to put the target range for the federal funds rate up 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent", "The meeting wrapped up at 10:15 a.m. on September 16, 2026."
dinkum-3.sense: Each term fits: "the unemployment rate had hardly budged", "growing at a solid clip", "That same vote also gave the nod to the statement below".
dinkum-3.authenticity: Sounds natural throughout: "inflation was still sitting up high against the Committee's 2 percent goal", "dead set on hitting its dual-mandate goals". "percent" stays US.
dinkum-3.register: A clear but restrained Aussie layer on the prose, lighter than level 4: "It was agreed the Committee's next meeting would be on Tuesday–Wednesday, October 27–28, 2026."
dinkum-3.tone: Keeps the minutes' sober tone under a plainer voice: "The Committee made it plain it's still dead set on hitting its dual-mandate goals".
dinkum-3.flow: Smooth throughout: "Members noted the unemployment rate had hardly budged, and that the economy had kept on growing at a solid clip".
dinkum-3.variety: Decent spread ("put up", "stuck by", "solid clip", "gave the nod", "bump"), with "wrapped up" used twice.
dinkum-3.essence: Clearly the original minutes: "Voting against this action: None."

engine.meaning: Untranslated, except that the formal quoted statement is altered: "The Federal Open Market Committee reckoned the following statement was a goer for release by a 12–0 vote". Changing a verbatim quotation misreports the record.
engine.sense: The two swaps strain: "reckoned the following statement was a goer" turns formal approval into an opinion, and "voted unanimously to give a 1/4 percentage point increase the nod in the primary credit rate" garbles the phrase.
engine.authenticity: The two Aussie bits are bolted into formal prose: "voted unanimously to give a 1/4 percentage point increase the nod in the primary credit rate to 4.0 percent".
engine.register: Essentially the original for a level-4 brief: "The Committee underlined its continuing resolve to achieve its dual-mandate goals by indicating in its postmeeting statement".
engine.tone: Formal tone kept, except the slang dropped into the quoted statement jars: "reckoned the following statement was a goer".
engine.flow: Reads as the source except a broken join: "to give a 1/4 percentage point increase the nod in the primary credit rate to 4.0 percent".
engine.essence: The original minutes, nearly verbatim: "Committee Policy Actions".

unharnessed.meaning: Every point kept and quotes left verbatim. "doubled down on the FOMC's policy" overstates "reaffirmed", and "Not a single bugger." replaces "None." in the vote record.
unharnessed.sense: Mostly fits ("voted as one", "gave the thumbs-up, no dissenters", "knocked off"), but "doubled down" means escalated, not reaffirmed, and "the yakking" casts the discussion as idle chatter.
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural in places ("dead set on hitting", "next get-together"), but "doubled down" is American and "the whole lot of members" is clumsy.
unharnessed.register: Level-4 voice with a dad-level swear: "Voting against this action: Not a single bugger."
unharnessed.tone: The sober minutes turn mocking in places: "When the yakking wrapped up", "Not a single bugger."
unharnessed.flow: Mostly smooth, with a clunky opener: "the whole lot of members agreed to bump the target range".
unharnessed.variety: Varied: "bump", "doubled down", "crystal clear", "yakking", "voted as one", "thumbs-up", "get-together", "knocked off".
unharnessed.essence: Recognisably the minutes, structure intact: "Notation Vote".

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every point kept, quotes verbatim: "the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System voted unanimously to bump up the interest rate paid on reserve balances to 3.90 per cent".
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "the unemployment rate had barely shifted", "inflation was still running high", "give a 1/4 percentage point increase the nod".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural throughout, with "per cent" spelt the local way; "solid growth in economic activity had kept on" is a little stiff.
yarn-dinkum.register: A restrained Aussie layer, lighter than level 4: "At the end of the discussion, the Committee voted to direct the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, until told otherwise".
yarn-dinkum.tone: The sober tone is kept: "The Committee made it clear it's still dead set on hitting its dual-mandate goals".
yarn-dinkum.flow: Smooth, except the slightly unfinished "solid growth in economic activity had kept on".
yarn-dinkum.variety: Some spread ("lift", "stuck with", "dead set", "bump up", "the nod", "signed off"), nothing leaned on heavily.
yarn-dinkum.essence: Clearly the original minutes: "Voting against this action: None."
